verdict.rationale: Khoj's own telemetry docs describe a direct opt-out: set the KHOJ_TELEMETRY_DISABLE environment variable to True, at any time. A community comment said the PostHog telemetry was undocumented with no clear opt-out, but that reflects missing docs at the time, not a report that the documented switch fails, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: details on what telemetry is collected and what the switch disables, opt-out for Khoj Cloud users or the client apps, and independent hands-on confirmation that the variable stops tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: you can opt out of telemetry at any time by setting the KHOJ_TELEMETRY_DISABLE environment variable to True
